title: Tomcat manager application disclosed
description: The response is the Tomcat manager application: the manager heading together with the Server Information block and the deploy form identifies the administrative console. That console deploys and undeploys web applications.
remediation: Remove the manager application from production, or restrict it to an administrative network with a manager role and a strong credential. Never publish /manager on the application ingress.
limitation: One response body. The rule reports the manager page; it does not submit the deploy form and cannot show whether the request would be authorised.
